declarations.docstring: Rational algebraicity of complex numbers is preserved by addition and multiplication, and by inversion of a nonzero number.
The subtype of complex numbers algebraic over the rationals is algebraically closed.
The rational-algebraic complex numbers form an algebraic closure of the rationals.
Every element of the rational-algebraic complex-number subtype is algebraic over the rationals.
Integral complex numbers over the integers are closed under addition and multiplication.
The integer subalgebra of complex numbers consisting of elements integral over the integers.
The rational intermediate field of complex numbers consisting of elements algebraic over the rationals.
A complex number belongs to the designated integer subalgebra exactly when it is integral over the integers.
A complex number belongs to the designated rational subfield exactly when it is algebraic over the rationals.
